title: ADMIL: Attention-Distilled Multiple Instance Learning for Selective Foundation Model Inference in Pathology
abstract: arXiv:2608.22066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) using pathology foundation model embeddings is effective for slide-level tasks, but exhaustive inference requires applying a large image encoder to every foreground tile despite the subsequent attention distribution often concentrating over a small subset of informative regions. We introduce ADMIL (Attention-Distilled Multiple Instance Learning), a selective-compute framework that distills an ABMIL teacher's attention into a lightweight tile-selection model, PriorNet. Using an EfficientNet architecture, PriorNet learns the teacher attention distribution from raw tile pixels with KL divergence; at inference, it scores the foreground pool, selects the top-K tiles, and invokes the expensive foundation model only on that subset before a selected-bag ABMIL student predicts the slide label. Across BRACS, PANDA, and CAMELYON16, ADMIL matches full-teacher headline performance at K=4, 8, and 12

translated_title: ADMIL：用于病理学中选择性基础模型推理的注意力蒸馏多实例学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：基于注意力的多实例学习（ABMIL）结合病理学基础模型嵌入在幻灯片级任务中表现出色，但全面推理需要对每个前景图块应用大型图像编码器，尽管后续的注意力分布通常集中在少量信息丰富的区域。我们引入了ADMIL（注意力蒸馏多实例学习），这是一种选择性计算框架，将ABMIL教师的注意力蒸馏到一个轻量级的图块选择模型PriorNet中。PriorNet采用EfficientNet架构，通过KL散度从原始图块像素学习教师注意力分布；在推理时，它评分前景池，选择前K个图块，仅对该子集调用昂贵的基础模型，然后由选定的包ABMIL学生模型预测幻灯片标签。在BRACS、PANDA和CAMELYON16数据集上，ADMIL在K=4、8和12时匹配了全教师的主要性能。
tldr: ADMIL通过蒸馏教师注意力到轻量级选择模型，仅对关键图块调用昂贵基础模型，在保持性能的同时大幅降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: ADMIL distills teacher attention into a lightweight selection model, invoking expensive foundation models only on key tiles, maintaining performance while significantly reducing compute.
